pages.title: FIELDLOCK
pages.creator: Atchayam Play
pages.description:
FIELDLOCK is a physics puzzle about guiding lost energy cores through chambers beneath a city. Move an electromagnetic rig around the edge of the room and switch between pulling and pushing. You cannot pick up a core directly; its route depends on how you apply the field.

Later chambers introduce breakable glass, reflecting shields, charge-operated gates, moving currents, gravity wells, rotating arms, and accumulating heat. The final challenge involves two cores. Study how the chamber changes their movement and adjust the rig's position to guide each core toward the exit.

pages.title: SPEED WILDS
pages.creator: Luma
pages.description: SPEED WILDS mixes kart racing with weapons and drifting. Race across looping tracks, use nitro, and deploy items such as missiles, banana peels, or shields against rivals. Unlock additional vehicles as you work on combining cornering with combat.

pages.title: Threads
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Sort falling fabric onto matching spools in Threads. Place the spools so each colored thread winds onto the correct one. More colors and faster movement complicate later levels, making quick placement decisions and planning equally important.

pages.title: One Shot Tower : Physics Destroyer
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Collapse enemy structures in One Shot Tower : Physics Destroyer. Adjust a cannon's angle and power, then fire a shot intended to topple the entire tower. Each puzzle asks you to find a hit that removes both the structure and its defenders.

pages.title: Road To 7
pages.creator: soundlygame
pages.description: Combine numbers along a set route in Road To 7. Use addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division on neighboring values, keeping every result an integer from zero to nine. Merge the whole path so the final remaining number is seven.

pages.title: Packing Line
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Keep a can-packing conveyor moving in Packing Line. Send boxes onto the platform and match their colors to the cans being shipped. Space is limited, so choosing the wrong boxes can fill the available area and stop the line.

pages.title: 2 Player Games Kids Kitchen
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Run a restaurant with a partner in 2 Player Games Kids Kitchen. Share cooking tasks in the virtual kitchen and explore the available modes. The game places cooperation alongside managing a restaurant, letting friends work on the food service together.

pages.title: Coe Snake
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Collect fruit while guiding a snake through hazards in Coe Snake. Avoid walls, meteors, bombs, and bouncing balls as you move. Different modes and scenarios alter the challenge, giving you new settings in which to keep the snake alive.

pages.title: Santa Go
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Draw a sliding route to the sleigh in Santa Go. Santa follows your line, so shape it to avoid obstacles that knock him over. Reaching the sleigh is only part of the task: he must remain inside for three seconds.

pages.title: Dino Game
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Run through a desert in Dino Game, jumping cacti and avoiding flying hazards as the pace rises. Play alone for a personal high score or share the screen in two- or three-player modes. Additional dinosaurs provide unlockable characters for later runs.

pages.title: Shelter Security: Gatekeeper Simulator
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Decide who enters a post-apocalyptic refuge in Shelter Security: Gatekeeper Simulator. Check documents and luggage to distinguish residents from dangerous visitors. Accept or reject each applicant while watching for disguises, contraband, and the tricks of would-be intruders.

pages.title: Capybara Suika
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Drop food pieces into a merging puzzle in Capybara Suika. Combine matching pieces to create larger food and increase your score. The capybara-themed game centers on choosing placements that keep useful merges available as the collection grows.

pages.title: Home Rush The Fish War
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Guide a human fighter to a fish opponent in Home Rush The Fish War. Match their colors, avoid hazards on the route, and return to the starting point after winning. The puzzle involves planning both the approach and the safe journey back.

pages.title: Limited Defense
pages.creator: Kool Games
pages.description: Deploy defenders against approaching waves in Limited Defense. Place archers, bandits, and explosive towers, then upgrade or sell them as the battle changes. Stronger enemies and bosses require you to keep adjusting the force protecting your position.

pages.title: Farmer Pedro
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build a crop business in Farmer Pedro. Drive a tractor around the fields, harvest produce, and turn it into cash. Use your earnings to expand the farmland, connecting each harvest with the next stage of your growing operation.

pages.title: Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Choose and improve a fighting vehicle in Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D. Move the tank, adjust its aim, and fire at enemies during battlefield encounters. Upgrades let you strengthen your selected machine before taking on further opposition.

pages.title: Thrill Roller Coaster
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Control a speeding ride in Thrill Roller Coaster. Press and hold to accelerate along the track, building enough speed to reach its far end. Watch the braking sections as you manage the coaster's momentum through the course.

pages.title: Hamster Apartment Game
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Plan candy-delivery routes in Hamster Apartment Game. Solve placement puzzles to bring sweets to the hamsters and collect stars. Expand the house as you progress, creating space for additional animal residents and more delivery challenges.

pages.title: Professor Parking
pages.creator: Neela Mediatech Private Limited
pages.description: Guide Bhide's scooter through a block maze in Professor Parking. Begin on the flagged block and tap neighboring spaces to make a route across the entire arrangement. Complete the maze to bring the scooter to its intended parking place.

pages.title: Bottle Jump 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Flip a plastic bottle across household objects in Bottle Jump 3D. Tap at the right moment to launch it toward the next surface. Judge the gap and landing position as you cross rooms and try to reach the finish.

pages.title: Animals Halves Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Complete animal pictures in Animals Halves Match. Study a patterned half and choose its symmetrical partner from the board. You have three lives, and an incorrect selection removes one, so comparing the shapes and markings carefully matters.

pages.title: Minigolf Archipelago
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Play miniature golf across island courses in Minigolf Archipelago. Hold the aiming control to line up a shot, then release to strike the ball. Work around the obstacles on each course as you guide it toward the hole.

pages.title: 100 Doors Escape Room
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Investigate a mysterious estate in 100 Doors Escape Room. Interact with objects, solve the room's puzzles, and uncover the means to open the next door. The sequence combines escape challenges with the story of Lord Kelly's lost property.

pages.title: Ripple Jump
pages.creator: Peaky Muzzle
pages.description: Time one-tap launches in Ripple Jump to move between circular areas without hitting hazards. Wait for an opening before sending the character onward. The levels focus on choosing a safe moment to jump rather than steering throughout the movement.

pages.title: Geography Quiz
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Test knowledge of countries and continents in Geography Quiz. Choose answers about flags, capitals, landmarks, maps, and currencies. Different modes present questions or images with answer options, letting you work through several kinds of geographic identification.

pages.title: Kitten Hide And Seek
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Help a girl avoid a watchful cat in Kitten Hide And Seek. Move through the challenge to collect the required props without being discovered. Completing levels awards items you can use to decorate the character's room.

pages.title: Angry Rex Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Control a destructive dinosaur in Angry Rex Online. Move and jump through side-scrolling stages, attack soldiers, and smash vehicles blocking the route. Avoid traps while carrying the rampage through successive levels of enemies and scenery.

pages.title: Candy Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match sweets and complete collection tasks in Candy Match 2. Larger combinations create stronger power-ups to help remove stones and other obstacles. Progress through the candy-themed stages, with daily missions and challenges offering additional rewards.

pages.title: Happy Easter Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Throw eggs toward a balloon basket in Happy Easter Game. Aim and release while accounting for the rabbit pilot's unstable movement. The basket shifts up, down, and sideways, making each toss a matter of judging where the target will be.

pages.title: Diamond Colors Art
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Build pictures from numbered gems in Diamond Colors Art. Fill the canvas with diamonds matching the indicated numbers and reveal the artwork section by section. Choose among the gallery's images and adjust the view as the designs become more detailed.

pages.title: Mi Adventures
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Collect colored gems by dividing the character in Mi Adventures. Split Mi into smaller descendants and change their departure angle to reach different parts of the puzzle. A limit restricts how often you can divide, making each split a planned move.

pages.title: Red and Green Pumpkin
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cross a monster-filled course with two characters in Red and Green Pumpkin. Collect the key to reveal the exit, use jump ramps, and avoid bats and slime. Only the green character can remove lasers, giving the pair different responsibilities.

pages.title: Caitlyn Dress Up Autumn
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Prepare a seasonal outfit in Caitlyn Dress Up Autumn. Combine colorful clothing with bags, earrings, hats, and other accessories for rainy, chilly weather. Try different arrangements from the wardrobe to give Caitlyn a complete autumn look.

pages.title: Pop It Bubble Game
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Press the raised bubbles on shaped boards in Pop It Bubble Game. Work across each design to pop its sections, then unlock additional board shapes. The activity focuses on the simple process of tapping bubbles rather than solving a complicated puzzle.

pages.title: Penalty Kick Sport Game
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Aim football shots past a goalkeeper in Penalty Kick Sport Game. Score points with successful goals and keep playing as the pace increases. The attempt ends when the keeper saves three balls, so each shot counts toward extending your run.

pages.title: Lof Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear connected groups in Lof Blocks until the board is empty. Larger groups can provide power-ups, while removing a lone block costs points. Choose the order of your collections carefully so the remaining layout does not leave too many isolated pieces.

pages.title: Zombie Drift
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Use a car against the undead in Zombie Drift. Steer through each level and hit the zombies without relying on handheld weapons. The game turns driving into combat, making your vehicle the tool for clearing the enemies around you.

pages.title: Aviation Art Air Combat Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore aerial battle illustrations in Aviation Art Air Combat Slide. Choose an image and a grid measuring three, four, or five squares per side. Rearrange the scrambled sections until the aircraft scene forms a complete picture.

pages.title: Monsters Jumper
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Climb with a cartoon creature in Monsters Jumper. Tap the left or right side of the screen to jump in that direction and keep gaining height. Higher progress lets you unlock more monster characters for subsequent attempts.

pages.title: Learning Farm Animals: Educational Games For Kids
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Explore farm animals through interactive activities in Learning Farm Animals: Educational Games For Kids. Use the mouse to work through the farm-themed tasks. The game introduces domestic animals through a collection of activities centered on recognizing and interacting with them.

pages.title: Press To Push Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Operate spring mechanisms to send blocks into holes in Press To Push Online. Work out which pushers to activate first so the cubes arrive in the right places. A wrong sequence can spoil the solution, making order central to each puzzle.

pages.title: Police Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble patrol-vehicle pictures in Police Cars Puzzle. Six images offer puzzles with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Select a piece count and arrange the scattered sections to restore the chosen police-car illustration.

pages.title: Happy Summer Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Rebuild seasonal scenes in Happy Summer Jigsaw Puzzle. Drag each piece to its proper position in one of six pictures. Three grid sizes change the difficulty, letting you choose between a compact arrangement and a more detailed summer puzzle.

pages.title: Coach Bus Drive Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Drive passengers between stops in Coach Bus Drive Simulator. Use the map to locate the nearest station and guide your chosen bus there. Multiple vehicles and three modes offer different ways to practice steering, braking, and handling the coach.

pages.title: Cassoulet
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Follow a cooking sequence in Cassoulet to prepare a traditional casserole. Work through the illustrated recipe steps and combine its meat and white-bean ingredients. The game centers on making the dish by following the instructions given at each stage.

pages.title: Virus Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Help a scientist remove colored virus targets in Virus Bubble Shooter. Aim into the formation and clear matching pieces to work through the challenge. The scientist-and-vaccine theme frames a bubble-shooting puzzle about eliminating the viruses on the board.

pages.title: Spin Wheel
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Spin Wheel offers a points-based wheel-of-chance game. Spin for a result, then use the second wheel for a chance to increase the total. That bonus opportunity also carries the possibility of losing the points you have gained.

pages.title: Slendrina Must Die The Asylum
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search an abandoned institution for eight medical books in Slendrina Must Die The Asylum. Explore while defending yourself against Slendrina and her mother. A pistol, MP5, and shotgun provide weapons as you investigate the threatening building.

pages.title: Air Hostess Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Help a couple share secret kisses during a flight in Air Hostess Kissing. Choose moments when nobody else is watching and stop before the surrounding passengers notice. The challenge revolves around timing the romantic interaction without attracting attention.

pages.title: Indian Taxi 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Work as a city cab driver in Indian Taxi 2020. Find your vehicle, collect passengers at pickup points, and deliver them to their destinations. Keyboard steering and adjustable camera views help you handle the taxi throughout its urban routes.

pages.title: Mr. Lupato and Eldorado Treasure
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Jump toward hidden riches in Mr. Lupato and Eldorado Treasure. Collect gems and keys, then open the door at each level's end. Additional jumps and secret stages provide further discoveries as you guide the explorer through the platforming adventure.

pages.title: Beautiful Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild automobile photographs in Beautiful Cars Slide. Choose one of three pictures and a puzzle mode, then rearrange its sections. Compare the vehicle's details across the pieces as you work toward restoring the complete image.

pages.title: Happy Dog Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Remember card positions in Happy Dog Memory. Reveal tiles, find identical pairs, and clear the board with as few moves as possible. Four levels provide different arrangements, rewarding careful use of the pictures you have already uncovered.

pages.title: Renault Captur Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Renault Captur Puzzle offers six car pictures to assemble. Select a puzzle with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces and fit each section into position. The piece-count options change how much of the vehicle image you must reconstruct.

pages.title: ABCs of Halloween 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble illustrated holiday pictures in ABCs of Halloween 3. Choose among six images and four difficulty options, from 16 to 100 pieces. Study each section and fit the jigsaw together to reveal the completed Halloween scene.

pages.title: Crazy Jump Halloween
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Help Dash climb past ghosts in Crazy Jump Halloween. Keep moving upward while avoiding contact with the spectral enemies in his path. A collision ends the attempt, so the challenge is to gain height without touching a ghost.

pages.title: Princesses BFF Rush to School
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Pack for class in Princesses BFF Rush to School. Search a cluttered room for the objects shown on the list, including school supplies and personal items. Gather everything the princesses need so they can finish preparing their backpacks.

pages.title: Let Me Out
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Clear an exit lane in Let Me Out. Drag the cars and trucks that are blocking your vehicle, reorganizing the crowded parking area until it can leave. Every moved vehicle changes the space available for the next part of the solution.

pages.title: Fish Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Help a small fish by clearing colored bubbles in Fish Bubble Shooter. Aim shots to create groups of at least three matching bubbles. Remove the formations through careful placement as you work through the fish-themed puzzle.

pages.title: Offroad Indian Truck Hill Drive
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Deliver freight along narrow routes in Offroad Indian Truck Hill Drive. Follow signs toward the destination and steer your selected truck through hilly terrain. Keep the load aboard: dropping cargo immediately causes the delivery attempt to fail.

pages.title: Ant Smash
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Stop insects before they reach your defensive line in Ant Smash. Tap the approaching ants and bugs as their movement varies between patterns. Avoid the fly while trying to keep the invasion back and increase your score.

pages.title: Crazy Snakes
pages.creator: Mohamed Kbiri
pages.description: Guide a snake in a competitive arena in Crazy Snakes. Play in the game's shared contest with or against friends and try to keep your creature alive. The challenge centers on handling your snake among the other competitors.

pages.title: Baby Doll Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Assemble photographs of dolls in Baby Doll Jigsaw. Choose one of twelve pictures and an easy, medium, or hard setting. The puzzles have no timer, allowing you to compare piece shapes and complete each doll image at your preferred pace.

pages.title: Paint Pop 3D 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Apply paint with timed taps in Paint Pop 3D 2. Hold to continue painting, but release when obstacles threaten to interrupt your shots. Complete a level to open another part of the game and work through further painting challenges.

pages.title: Forest Game
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Swap neighboring fruit pieces in Forest Game to form rows of matching items. Lines of at least three identical fruits disappear from the board. Look across the layout for useful exchanges and continue clearing groups through the match-three puzzle.

pages.title: Stars and Clouds
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Collect stars among the clouds in Stars and Clouds. Guide the ball toward the remaining targets before the level's timer expires. An hourglass provides additional time, helping you complete the nine stages while keeping the collection moving.

pages.title: EG Neon Rider
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Ride through a neon course in EG Neon Rider. Customize the bike, road, and background before trying to travel as far as possible without crashing. The run challenges you to keep the motorcycle moving while protecting it from a fatal mistake.

pages.title: Princess Make Donut
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help a princess make a homemade dessert in Princess Make Donut. First shop for the ingredients she needs, then return to prepare the doughnuts. Follow the cooking activity from purchasing supplies through making the finished treats.

pages.title: EG Candy Land
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Arrange matching sweets in EG Candy Land. Find groups of three or more pieces with the same color to clear them from the board. The puzzle centers on spotting useful matches among the candy-themed pieces.

pages.title: Epic Cube Roll
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Steer a rolling block through hazardous mazes in Epic Cube Roll. Tap to change its rolling direction as it approaches obstacles and traps. Accurate timing keeps the cube on a safe path through each block-built course.

pages.title: Eat Healthy Food
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Move a character around food choices in Eat Healthy Food. Drag to collect apples while keeping away from the fast-food items scattered through the play area. The task depends on steering toward the requested food and avoiding the unwanted alternatives.

pages.title: Ducky Duckie
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Help ducks reach the safe area in Ducky Duckie. Move the platform to redirect them through the playfield and away from danger. Complete the game's tasks while trying to increase your score and preserve the ducks' route to safety.

pages.title: Emilys Dream
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight through an action adventure in Emilys Dream. Choose from multiple weapons, manage the available inventory, and prepare for a boss encounter. The game centers on its combat system, with your equipment supporting the battles along the way.

pages.title: College Toga Party Dressup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare three students for a themed celebration in College Toga Party Dressup. Choose outfits and makeup for Emma, Mia, and Belle. Work through each character's options to create individual looks for the college party.

pages.title: Tower Defense
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Place defensive weapons in the jungle in Tower Defense. Choose among the available battery types and position them to prevent enemy attacks from advancing. The challenge connects your deployment choices with protecting the route through the forest setting.

pages.title: Music Line2 Christmas
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Guide a moving line through seasonal courses in Music Line2 Christmas. Follow the route and time changes of direction to keep progressing. Six levels, day and night settings, and purchasable cube designs provide different ways to continue the music-themed challenge.

pages.title: Instant Online Soccer
pages.creator: Rezoner
pages.description: Play football alone or with friends in Instant Online Soccer. Learn the special moves, control possession, and pass to teammates to move play forward. Carrying the ball slows you down, making the timing of a pass especially useful.

pages.title: Ninja Bridge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Build crossings for a ninja in Ninja Bridge. Extend his black stick across each gap and use it to continue the journey. Keep completing bridges to raise your score, judging the span needed for the next crossing.

pages.title: Car Chase
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a getaway vehicle in Car Chase. Collect coins while keeping your fast-moving car under control, then use the earnings to buy additional cars. The top-down driving challenge uses left and right steering as you continue the escape.

pages.title: Treasure Island
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Remove matching, uncovered tiles in Treasure Island to work toward pirate riches. Complete each layout within its allotted time and gather as many points as possible. Helpers can reveal available tiles or rearrange the board when progress stalls.

pages.title: Pixel Battle Royale
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Search for weapons and fight to survive in Pixel Battle Royale. Explore the map, collect equipment, and confront other shooters while aiming to become the last survivor. Use the inventory to manage weapons and the map to track your surroundings.

pages.title: Octopus Blast
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Start chain reactions in Octopus Blast by bursting selected elements. Your goal is to clear every piece from the level, using the spreading reactions to reach them. Faster solutions earn more stars as you work through the puzzle sequence.

pages.title: The Easter Memory
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Find matching card pairs in The Easter Memory. Tap to reveal pictures, remember their positions, and uncover identical cards together. Clear the complete arrangement before the timer expires to finish the seasonal memory challenge.

pages.title: Penguin Quest
pages.creator: Solstice Games
pages.description: Push a penguin's stolen egg back to its nest in Penguin Quest. Open a route through the ground while keeping the egg safe. Breaking away too much terrain can threaten it, so your digging and pushing need to work together.

pages.title: Birdy Rush
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Keep a bird clear of falling crates in Birdy Rush. Collect grains and climb vertical surfaces to escape dangerous positions. Continue surviving the drops as you work toward unlocking additional birds and scenery for later attempts.

pages.title: Slither Birds
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Grow a strange bird-like creature in Slither Birds by eating others. Guide it through the contest and pursue opportunities to become longer. The game's central challenge is expanding your creature while competing with the other slithering birds.

pages.title: Mechar.io
pages.creator: Rezoner
pages.description: Pilot an armed mech against opponents in Mechar.io. Collect weapons and power-ups, use a shield for protection, and bash enemies to break their defenses. Successful fighting depends on balancing ranged attacks with well-timed melee encounters.

pages.title: Airboss
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Manage aircraft arrivals and departures in Airboss. Land planes, authorize takeoffs, and avoid crashes while earning the income required for each level. Emergency aircraft cannot be slowed, adding urgent traffic decisions to the airport's routine operation.

pages.title: Girl on Skates: Flower Power
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Run a flower-delivery service in Girl on Skates: Flower Power. Prepare customer orders and take them out for delivery, handling obstacles along the skating route. Earn money and improve the business with upgrades to its equipment, staff, and other facilities.

pages.title: Sweet Astronomy: Donut Galaxy
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Swap space-themed sweets into matching groups in Sweet Astronomy: Donut Galaxy. Clear the board's tasks through the match-three puzzles and deal with alien infection tiles by making the required swaps. Progress depends on using the available arrangement to complete each level's objectives.
